headline: Markets brace for potential volatility ahead as Fed contemplates fewer meetings
detail: Fewer Fed meetings could mean less frequent communication, leading to market uncertainty and increased volatility. This is especially risky for your leveraged positions (SOXL, SPAL) as drawdowns are amplified.
rec: No action needed directly from this, but be aware of the heightened risk for your leveraged holdings.

headline: Sandisk's stock falls as forecast doesn't live up to high expectations
detail: A chip company missing forecasts due to high expectations signals potential weakness or overvaluation in the broader semiconductor sector. This could put pressure on your SOXL and SMH positions.
rec: Consider reviewing your SMH position (TRIM status, -10.48% loss) and its stop at 540.

headline: Figma, SpaceX stocks fall as AI push requires steep investments / Wall Street spooked by AI spending
detail: The market is reacting negatively to companies spending heavily on AI, even if it's for future growth. This indicates a shift in investor sentiment, potentially penalizing high-growth tech names with significant R&D.
rec: Given the general tech/AI sentiment, re-evaluate your SOXL (SELL status, -48.11% loss) and SPAL (NEW status, -62.31% loss) positions, especially their stops. Margin amplifies these drops.
